text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell tool in this session, so please run it to confirm.

- **`fees.py`:** the late fee now multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE`. It was adding them.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending policy comment.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`. I also made it return `[]` when `n <= 0`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` now includes `Emma` by Austen, 1815, 1 copy. The author, year and copies come from `test_search.py`, since `factory.py` only gave the title.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. It was importing from a module that doesn't exist.

I didn't change any tests.
